# @hondo/core

Core host-tree, bridge and event types for Hondo.

Most applications should install `@hondo/solid`, which depends on this package. Direct consumers can use `HondoHost`, `NativeMutationBridge`, `RecordingMutationBridge`, host installation helpers and node-event types.

See the repository `docs/api.md` and `docs/compatibility.md` for the v0.1.0 API and support matrix.
